reply_text:
I couldn't confirm ticket #6980 for Tamsin Cold Chain's gate kiosk outage. I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team to say so.

I only looked at what Hollis can see himself: the recent #central-team history and the shared files. Neither has anything about Tamsin Cold Chain, a gate kiosk outage or that ticket number, and there's no Tamsin account folder. I didn't use message search, because its results include conversations he can't see.

In the reply I said we'll treat #6980 as unverified, and won't log it or pass it on as the ticket number until someone checks it with support or with Tamsin directly.
